feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

feedback.critique:
For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG suggests tracking custom milestones with alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include setting, adjusting conditions, and receiving alerts for these milestones.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive alerts when nearing or reaching them', but the HLG'できて prime only captures notification functionality. The documentation supports both milestone definition and notification. The parent should be rewritten to explicitly include both milestone definition and notification to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG incorrectly scopes bulk operations to administrators. Documentation allows all users to export their own activity data, not just administrators. Preserve individual export while restricting bulk operations to administrators.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the original HLG implies bulk operations. Rewrite to explicitly mention aggregation, import, and export for reporting, migration, and backup.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The documentation supports these features. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Define and track user-defined milestones for fitness goals': the original HLG conflates milestone definition with notification. Documentation supports defining milestones but does not require real-time alerts. Preserve milestone customization while removing notification functionality.

For 'Support scalable user management and data export/import capabilities': the HLG's description includes 'manage user accounts' and 'generate user activity summaries', which are not fully captured by the HLG' prime. The parent should be rewritten to include user account management and activity summaries alongside bulk data export/import to ensure all supported functionality is preserved.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG suggests generic, step-by-step routines. Rewrite to emphasize dynamic adaptation based on user progress.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the reconstructed goal (HLG') suggests dynamic adaptation based on progress, while the original HLG focuses on onboarding and step-by-step routines. The documentation supports both structured onboarding and progressive plans. The HLG should be rewritten to include both structured onboarding and dynamic progression to fully represent the functionality expressed by the LLGs.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': HLG' specifies encryption, role-based access, and logging. Expand original to include these concrete security measures while maintaining broader integrity focus.

The documentation confirms the importance of security and reliability. The HLG should be rewritten to include specific security measures like encryption and auditing to better reflect the functionality expressed by the LLGs.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': HLG' emphasizes global deployment. Clarify that administrators manage workout libraries, settings, and feature updates without losing the global scope.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits progress tracking notifications, which are supported by documentation. Preserve goal-setting while including progress monitoring and notification functionality.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': requirements suggest supporting goal definition but lack explicit tools for progress tracking. Rewrite to include mechanisms for monitoring and updating user-defined goals, ensuring all aspects of goal management are covered.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG'prime indicates progress tracking and notifications, but the original HLG focuses on defining objectives and monitoring progress. The documentation supports both goal setting and progress monitoring. The HLG should be updated to include both goal definition and progress tracking/notifications to fully represent the required functionality.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG incorrectly broadens scope to include dynamic adaptation, which is a Fitness Enthusiast feature. Restrict to beginner-specific guidance while preserving milestone-based progression.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': requirements emphasize structured onboarding but lack clarity on how these plans evolve. Rewrite to detail the dynamic adaptation of workout routines based on user feedback and progress, ensuring all stages of development are addressed.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the HLG'prime focuses on dynamic adaptation, while the original HLG includes structured onboarding and milestone-based progression. The documentation requires both structured content and dynamic adaptation. The HLG should be rewritten to encompass both structured onboarding and dynamic adaptation to ensure all required functionality is preserved.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original HLG omits audit logging, which is supported by documentation. Preserve security controls while including comprehensive auditing of access and modifications.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the HLG'prime focuses on security and auditing, whereas the original HLG includes reliability and performance. The documentation specifies that system integrity includes both security and performance. The HLG should be rewritten to include both security/auditing and reliability/performance to maintain the functional scope.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': requirements cover deployment but lack explicit mention of user-facing updates. Rewrite to include mechanisms for communicating system changes to users, ensuring transparency in app evolution.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG'prime focuses on maintenance and updates, while the original HLG includes global deployment and feature updates. The documentation supports both. The HLG should be rewritten to include both maintenance and global deployment to ensure the full scope of functionality is preserved.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the original HLG omits operational insights, which are supported by documentation. Preserve user account management while including reporting and oversight capabilities.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the HLG'prime focuses on administration and export, while the original_hlg includes monitoring usage patterns and generating operational insights. The documentation requires both. The HLG should be rewritten to include both administration and operational insights to ensure all required functionality is preserved.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits progress tracking notifications, which are supported by documentation. Preserve goal-setting while including progress monitoring and notification functionality.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG incorrectly broadens scope to include dynamic adaptation, which is a Fitness Enthusiast feature. Restrict to beginner-specific guidance while preserving milestone-based progression.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original HLG omits audit logging, which is supported by documentation. Preserve security controls while including comprehensive auditing of access and modifications.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the original HLG omits operational insights, which are supported by documentation. Preserve user account management while including reporting and oversight capabilities.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': requirements suggest supporting goal definition but lack explicit tools for progress tracking. Rewrite to include mechanisms for monitoring and updating user-defined goals, ensuring all aspects of goal management are covered.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': requirements emphasize structured onboarding but lack clarity on how these plans evolve. Rewrite to detail the dynamic adaptation of workout routines based on user feedback and progress, ensuring all stages of development are addressed.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': requirements cover deployment but lack explicit mention of user-facing updates. Rewrite to include mechanisms for communicating system changes to users, ensuring transparency in app evolution.

The documentation supports both goal setting and progress monitoring. The HLG should be updated to include both goal definition and progress tracking/notifications to fully represent the required functionality.

The documentation requires both structured content and dynamic adaptation. The HLG should be rewritten to encompass both structured onboarding and dynamic adaptation to ensure all required functionality is preserved.

The HLG should be rewritten to include both security/auditing and reliability/performance to maintain the functional scope.

feedback.critique:
For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original HLG incorrectly assigns responsibility to the Administrator for user data privacy. Documentation confirms this is a system-wide concern, not an administrative function. Preserve all aspects of data security (encryption, access controls) while reassigning audit logging and reliability to the system's core functionality.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': requirements focus on secure storage, access controls, and audit logging. The parent should also explicitly include protection against unauthorized data access and potential breaches.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the reconstruction (hlg_prime) focuses on access management and auditing, but the original HLG description includes critical security features like encryption and role--based access controls, which are not fully captured in the reconstruction. The original HLG's scope of 'system integrity' and 'reliability' also exceeds the reconstructed scope. The rewrite should ensure that both data privacy (encryption, RBAC) and system integrity (reliability, performance) are preserved in the formulation.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original HLG incorrectly assigns responsibility to the Administrator for user data privacy. Documentation confirms this is a system-wide concern, not an administrative function. Preserve all aspects of data security (encryption, access controls) while reassigning audit logging and reliability to the system's core functionality.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': requirements focus on secure storage, access controls, and audit logging. The parent should also explicitly include protection against unauthorized data access and potential breaches.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': requirements cover usage monitoring, account management, and operational insights. The parent should also detail strategies for handling increased user load and ensuring system performance under growth.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the reconstruction (hlg_prime) focuses on access management and auditing, but the original HLG description includes critical security features like encryption and role--based access controls, which are not fully captured in the reconstruction. The original HLG's scope of 'system integrity' and 'reliability' also exceeds the reconstructed scope. The rewrite should ensure that both data privacy (encryption, RBAC) and system integrity (reliability, performance) are preserved in the formulation.

feedback.critique:
For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original HLG conflates privacy, access control, audit logging with reliability/performance. Documentation separates these into distinct concerns: privacy/access/audit (branch 5) and system reliability (implicit in branch 7). Preserve only secure storage, role-based access controls, and audit logging; remove reliability/performance aspects.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original goal focuses on data security, while the reconstructed version emphasizes data management. Rewrite to clearly encompass both aspects, ensuring secure storage, controlled access, and audit logging for reliable performance.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the HLG's description includes 'ensuring the app’s reliability and performance,' which is a broad system-level concern often managed via infrastructure and DevOps, rather than a direct privacy/integrity control. However, the HLG'prime requires 'audit all data interactions.' The documentation confirms that audit logging is a core requirement for integrity. The HLG should be refined to focus on the security and integrity of user data and system operations, removing the broader reliability/performance goals to better align with the actor's specific responsibilities.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks explicit support for notifications to track progress. Preserve goal-setting, progress monitoring, and add notification functionality as documented.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG does not clearly address the aspect of setting goals. Rewrite to explicitly include goal definition, tracking progress, and receiving notifications for staying on track.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG'prime' indicates that the goal is about tracking and notifying progress. While the documentation supports tracking and notifications, the original HLG also includes the core functionality of defining measurable fitness objectives. The rewrite should ensure that the goal encompasses both the definition of goals and the tracking/notification of progress to fully represent the supported functionality.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG incorrectly includes dynamic adaptation to user feedback, which is already covered by the Fitness Enthusiast's goal. Restrict to onboarding content, step-by-step routines, and milestone-based progression for beginners.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG lacks clarity on how the plan adapts to user feedback and progress. Rewrite to ensure dynamic adaptation is explicitly stated.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the HLG'prime' indicates a focus on dynamic adaptation based on user progress and feedback. The original HLG includes structured onboarding and milestone-based progression. The rewrite should ensure that the goal encompasses both the initial structured onboarding and the dynamic adaptation to build confidence and consistency.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG lacks explicit support for communicating system changes to users. Preserve global deployment of libraries and settings, then add user notification functionality as documented.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG does not sufficiently emphasize user notification about new features. Rewrite to include this aspect.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG'prime' indicates a focus on distributing and notifying users about new content and features. The original HLG includes global deployment and management of libraries, settings, and updates. The rewrite should ensure that the goal encompasses both the management of global content/configurations and the communication of these changes to users for transparency.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the original HLG lacks explicit support for monitoring usage patterns. Preserve account management, reporting, and add operational insights functionality as documented.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the original HLG lacks clarity on how operational insights are generated. Rewrite to explicitly mention this process.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the HLG'prime' indicates a focus on administrating user groups and system analytics for operational oversight. The original_hlg's description includes monitoring usage patterns, managing user accounts, and generating operational insights. The rewrite should ensure the goal encompasses both the management of user accounts and the generation of operational insights and analytics for scalable growth.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits notifications, which are required for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while adding notifications to align with supported functionality.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG focuses on goal definition, while the prime suggests tracking progress. Rewrite to clearly include both aspects: defining and monitoring personal fitness objectives.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG'prime shows that the reconstructed goals focus on tracking and notification of progress. The original HLG's description includes 'setting' goals, which is a core requirement for the fitness journey. The rewrite should ensure that both the ability to define measurable objectives and the and tracking/notification of progress are preserved.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG incorrectly includes milestone-based progression, which is not documented. Preserve onboarding content and step-by-step routines while removing milestone references.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG implies a linear, one-size-fits-all approach. Rewrite to emphasize dynamic, personalized routines that adapt based on user feedback and progress.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the HLG'prime shows that the reconstruction focuses on dynamic adaptation based on user feedback. The original HLG includes 'structured onboarding content' and 'step-by-step workout routines', which are essential for beginners. The rewrite must preserve the structured onboarding and step-by-step routines while maintaining the dynamic adaptation.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG omits user communication, which is required for transparency. Preserve global deployment while adding user notifications to align with supported functionality.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG suggests global deployment without user communication. Rewrite to include transparent notification of new content and features.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG'prime focuses on distributing and notifying users about new content. The original HLG includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries' and 'system settings'. The rewrite should ensure that the management of libraries and settings is preserved alongside the notification of changes.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the original HLG incorrectly includes operational insights, which are not documented. Preserve user account management while removing reporting references.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the original HLG focuses on operational oversight without emphasizing data-driven insights. Rewrite to highlight how system analytics can inform strategic growth decisions.

For 'Support scalable user management and data analytics': the HLG'prime focuses on administrating user groups and system analytics. The parent HLG's description includes 'monitor usage patterns', 'manage user accounts', and 'generate operational insights'. The rewrite should ensure that all these management and monitoring tasks are preserved to support scalable growth.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits notifications, which are required for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while adding notifications to align with supported functionality.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, which are required by the LLGs. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while adding support for automated notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks clarity on how progress is monitored and what types of notifications are provided. Rewrite to specify these details, ensuring all aspects of goal tracking and user engagement are covered.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive notifications to stay on track', but the reconstruction (HLG') focuses on defining parameters and automated milestone alerts. While similar, the documentation implies that monitoring progress and receiving notifications are core components of the goal. The original HLG's broader scope of 'setting and achieving' goals is well-supported by the project description's focus on 'setting fitness goals' and 'monitoring progress'. However, the NOT_EQUIVALENT flag suggests a mismatch in the specific notification mechanism. Since the reconstruction is more specific about 'milestone alerts', the original HLG should be kept as is to preserve the broader, supported functionality of goal setting and progress monitoring.

5.diagnostic: No two valid documentary actions agree.

feedback.critique:
For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG omits transparent user notifications, which are required. Preserve global deployment of workout libraries while adding support for notifying users about new features.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG does not adequately address user notification of new features or the method of deployment. Rewrite to include these elements, ensuring transparency in updates.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG's description includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries and system settings' and 'notifying users transparently'. The reconstruction (HLG') only mentions 'Distribute and notify users of new workout content'. This indicates that the original HLG's scope is broader and more complete than the reconstruction. However, the NOT_EQUIVALENT status and the documentation's focus on 'managing user data, app settings, and content' for the Administrator actor, and 'notifying users transparently' for content updates, requires the original HLG to be rewritten to more accurately reflect the functional boundaries of the Administrator's responsibilities. The rewrite should ensure it covers both content management and system configuration management, while preserving the notification aspect.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, which are required by the LLGs. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while adding support for automated notifications.

For 'Ensure user data privacy and system integrity': the original HLG lacks explicit mention of audit logging with timestamps, which is required. Preserve encryption and access controls while adding support for comprehensive audit trails.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original parent's description lacks explicit support for automated milestone alerts, which are required by HLG'. Preserve goal definition, progress monitoring, and add automated milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': requirements suggest supporting goal definition, tracking progress, and notifications. However, the parent does not explicitly mention data visualization for trend analysis or adaptive adjustments based on performance data. Preserve these elements while ensuring clear goal parameters and automated milestone alerts.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'receive notifications to stay on track,' but the reconstruction (hlg_prime) focuses on 'automated milestone alerts.' While both are notifications, 'milestone alerts' is a more specific and documented requirement for tracking progress. Rewrite to include 'milestone alerts' to better align with the reconstructed functionality.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original parent's description excludes user notifications, which are required by HLG'. Preserve global deployment and system settings management while adding transparent user notification for new content.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': requirements cover deployment, management, and user notifications. However, the parent lacks emphasis on transparent communication about new features or content. Rewrite to include this aspect while maintaining global distribution capabilities.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries and system settings' and 'notifying users transparently.' The reconstruction (hlg_prime) only mentions 'Distribute and notify users of new workout content.' It omits the management of system settings and the global deployment aspect. Rewrite to include 'system settings' and 'global deployment' to preserve the full scope of the original goal.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks explicit support for milestone alerts, which is required functionality. Preserve goal-setting, progress monitoring, and add automated milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG suggests general goal-setting functionality. However, documentation indicates a need for detailed tracking of progress towards these goals, including automated milestone alerts. Rewrite to ensure this nuanced functionality is preserved.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG' description includes 'automated milestone alerts', but the HLG' reconstruction only covers goal definition and notification. The project description emphasizes monitoring progress and staying on track. Preserve the 'automated milestone alerts' and 'monitor progress' functionality from the original HLG to ensure it fully reflects the requirements.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG excludes onboarding content, which is required. Preserve progressive adaptation while adding structured onboarding routines.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG implies a one-way, linear approach to learning. Documentation suggests a more flexible, responsive system that adapts based on user feedback in real-time. Rewrite to reflect this adaptive nature.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the HLG' reconstruction focuses on 'adapting progressively based on performance and feedback'. The original HLG description includes 'structured onboarding content' and 'build confidence and consistency'. These are key components for beginners as stated in the project description. The rewrite should preserve the onboarding content and the and the 'confidence and consistency' goals while maintaining the progressive adaptation.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG lacks version control and user awareness, which are required. Preserve global deployment while adding version tracking and notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG suggests basic content management. Documentation highlights a need for version control, user transparency regarding new features, and system-wide deployment capabilities. Rewrite to incorporate these aspects.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG' reconstruction mentions 'version control' and 'user awareness'. The original HLG description includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries and system settings' and 'transparently notifying users'. The HLG' reconstruction is more specific regarding 'version control', but the original HLG description is more comprehensive regarding the scope of 'workout libraries' and 'system settings'. Ensure the formulation reflects the full scope of content and configuration management.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks explicit mention of milestone alerts, which are required for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition, progress monitoring, and include milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG suggests general goal-setting, but lacks clarity on how to monitor progress or receive alerts. Rewrite to explicitly include these features, ensuring alignment with user tracking and analysis.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG' description includes 'automated milestone alerts', which is a key requirement for goal tracking. However, the HLG' reconstruction shows a focus on 'defining goals with parameters' and 'notifying upon milestone achievement'. To ensure the HLG remains complete and accurately represents the supported functionality, the HLG should be rewritten to explicitly include both the definition of goals with specific parameters and the automated milestone notifications, ensuring all requirements are captured.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG excludes onboarding content, which is required for beginner guidance. Preserve progressive adaptation but include structured onboarding routines.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG is too broad, lacking specifics on how progress adapts. Rewrite to detail the feedback-driven, step-by-step nature of these plans.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG's description mentions 'structured onboarding content' and 'step-by-step workout routines' that 'dynamically adapt based on user feedback and progress'. The HLG' reconstruction focuses on 'adapting user training progressively'. While the requirements specify structured onboarding and progressive routines, the original HLG is already comprehensive. However, a rewrite is proposed to ensure the formulation of 'dynamically adapt' and 'step-by-step' are clearly linked to the user's progress and feedback, reinforcing the consistency between the form and content. Preservation of the 'onboarding' and 'progressive' aspects is essential.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG lacks version control and user awareness, which are required for content management. Preserve global deployment but include versioning and notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG doesn't specify version control or user notification. Rewrite to include these elements for clarity.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG's description includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries and system settings' and 'transparently notifying users'. The HLG' reconstruction focuses on 'distribute and manage workout content with version control and user awareness'. The rewrite should ensure that 'system settings' and 'global deployment' are explicitly preserved as part of the content management functionality, as they are distinct from the workout libraries. The formulation should be clear that the user notification aspect is a key part of the goal.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original parent omits milestone alerts, which are explicitly required for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while adding automated milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks clarity on how progress is monitored and what specific milestone alerts are included. Rewrite to specify these aspects while maintaining the core functionality of goal definition, tracking, and alerting.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG's description includes 'automated milestone alerts', which is a specific feature not fully captured in the HLG'prime. However, the HLG'prime correctly identifies the core functionality of goal definition and progress tracking. To ensure full coverage, the rewrite should maintain the goal definition, progress monitoring, and milestone notification functionality as described in the project description.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original parent excludes version control, which is documented as a requirement. Preserve user notifications while adding version-controlled management of workout libraries and system settings.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG does not clearly distinguish between updating content and managing system settings. Rewrite to separate these responsibilities, ensuring that updates are distinct from configuration changes.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG'prime only mentions 'distribute and notify users', omitting the 'manage workout libraries and system settings with version control' and 'transparently notifying users' aspects. The original HLG is more comprehensive. The rewrite should ensure that the user-facing notification system is integrated with the content management and configuration updates to reflect the full scope of the requirements.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits milestone alerts, which are explicitly required. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while adding milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks clarity on how progress is measured or what specific parameters are involved. Rewrite to explicitly include these details while maintaining goal-setting functionality.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG' description includes 'automated milestone alerts', which are not explicitly mentioned in the HLG' reconstruction. However, the project description confirms that the app aims to help users 'receive personalized workout recommendations' and 'monitor progress'. The HLG' captures the core goal of goal-setting and progress tracking. To ensure the H_prime is fully represented, the original HLG should be updated to explicitly include the notification of milestones as a key functionality, or the HLG' should be expanded to include it. Since the HLG' is the evidence of the LLGs, the original HLG should be updated to reflect the core functionality of goal-setting and progress tracking with milestone notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG excludes version control and user notifications, which are documented requirements. Preserve global deployment while adding version tracking and transparent user updates.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG is overly broad. Rewrite to specify content types (e.g., workout libraries, system settings) and clarify deployment processes.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG' reconstruction ('Distribute and notify users of new workout content') is narrower in scope than the original HLG's description, which includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries and system settings with version control' and 'transparently notifying users'. The original HLG is more comprehensive and covers the requirements of the project description. The HLG' reconstruction should be expanded to include the management of system settings and version control, or the original HLG should be simplified to align with the goal of content distribution and user notification.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, which are required for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while including milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': requirements suggest more comprehensive goal management, including progress monitoring and milestone alerts. Rewrite to include these aspects while maintaining user-defined objectives.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the reconstruction HLG' suggests that the original HLG's description of 'automated milestone alerts' is not fully captured or is formulated differently. However, the project description confirms that the app aims to help users 'set fitness goals' and 'monitor progress'. The original HLG's inclusion of 'automated milestone alerts' is a supported functionality. The REWRITE is proposed because the reconstruction HLG' suggests a more concise formulation of 'defining goals with parameters' and 'notifying upon milestone achievement'. To ensure the original HLG's comprehensive scope (including 'measurable objectives' and 'automated alerts') is fully preserved, the REWRITE is proposed to align with the reconstruction's focus on 'defining goals with parameters' and 'notifying upon milestone achievement' while maintaining the original's comprehensive scope.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG excludes version control and user notifications, which are documented requirements. Preserve global deployment management while including version tracking and transparent user notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': requirements imply broader management capabilities, including version control and user notifications. Rewrite to reflect these expanded responsibilities.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the reconstruction HLG' suggests a more limited scope of 'Distribute and notify users of new workout content'. The original HLG's description includes 'globally deploy and manage workout libraries and system settings with version control' and 'transparently notifying users'. feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original parent omits automated milestone alerts, which are supported by documentation. Preserve goal definition and progress tracking while adding explicit support for milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG suggests defining goals with parameters, tracking progress, and receiving alerts. However, it lacks clarity on how these goals are set and monitored. Rewrite to include explicit steps for goal definition, regular progress checks, and clear alert conditions.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the reconstruction HLG' (Support user progress tracking by defining goals with parameters and notifying upon milestone achievement) indicates a narrower focus on progress tracking and notifications. However, the project description confirms that the original HLG's scope includes defining measurable objectives with specific parameters, monitoring progress, and receiving automated milestone alerts. The original HLG is more comprehensive and correctly captures the full scope of the requirements. The reconstruction should be updated to align with the full scope described in the original HLG.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original parent excludes version control and transparent user notifications, which are documented requirements. Preserve global deployment and management while adding explicit support for versioning and user notification.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG focuses on deploying and managing workout libraries and system settings. Rewrite to include explicit steps for version control, user notifications about new content/features, and a mechanism for transparent communication of updates.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the reconstruction HLG' (Distribute and notify users of new workout content) omits the critical administration tasks of globally deploying workout libraries, managing system settings with version control, and transparently notifying users. The original HLG covers these essential administrative functions. The reconstruction should be updated to reflect the full scope of the requirements. The original HLG should be kept but the reconstruction should be aware of the requirements.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original parent omits automated milestone alerts, which are supported by documentation. Preserve goal definition and progress tracking while adding explicit support for milestone notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original parent excludes version control and transparent user notifications, which are documented requirements. Preserve global deployment and management while adding explicit support for versioning and user notification.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG suggests defining goals with parameters, tracking progress, and receiving alerts. However, it lacks clarity on how these goals are set and monitored. Rewrite to include explicit steps for goal definition, regular progress checks, and clear alert conditions.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG focuses on deploying and managing workout libraries and system settings. Rewrite to include explicit steps for version control, user notifications about new content/features, and a mechanism for transparent communication of updates.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the reconstruction HLG' (Support user progress tracking by defining goals with parameters and notifying upon milestone achievement) indicates a narrower focus on progress tracking and notifications. However, the project description confirms that the original HLG's scope includes defining measurable objectives with specific parameters, monitoring progress, and receiving automated milestone alerts. The original HLG is more comprehensive and correctly captures the full scope of the requirements. The reconstruction should be updated to align with the full scope described in the original HLG.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the reconstruction HLG' (Distribute and notify users of new workout content) omits the critical administration tasks of globally deploying workout libraries, managing system settings with version control, and transparently notifying users. The original HLG covers these essential administrative functions. The reconstruction should be updated to reflect the full scope of the requirements. The original HLG should be kept but the reconstruction should be aware of the requirements.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, a critical feature for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while including milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks clarity on how progress is defined or tracked. Clarify these aspects while preserving goal-setting functionality.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG'prime suggests that the primary goal is progress tracking, whereas the documentation emphasizes defining measurable objectives with specific parameters and automated milestone alerts. The rewrite should ensure that the focus remains on goal definition and milestone notification as primary functionalities.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG excludes version control, a documented requirement for global deployments. Preserve user notifications while adding version-controlled management of workout libraries.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG is overly broad. Specify how administrators deploy, manage, and notify users about updates.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG'prime focuses only on distribution and notification, omitting the global management of workout libraries, system settings, and version control mentioned in the documentation. The rewrite must include these management and configuration capabilities while preserving the notification aspect.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, a critical feature for progress tracking. Preserve goal definition and progress monitoring while including milestone notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG excludes version control, a documented requirement for global deployments. Preserve user notifications while adding version-controlled management of workout libraries.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks clarity on how progress is defined or tracked. Clarify these aspects while preserving goal-setting functionality.
For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG is overly broad. Specify how administrators deploy, manage, and notify users about updates.

feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, which are required for progress tracking. Preserve goal-setting functionality while including milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG suggests setting goals with parameters but doesn't explicitly mention progress tracking or milestone alerts. Rewrite to include these elements, ensuring users can monitor their progress and receive automated notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG'prime' indicates that the reconstruction only covers goal definition and milestone notifications. The original HLG description includes 'monitor progress toward those goals', which is a core functionality for fitness tracking. feedback.critique:
For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, which are part of the supported functionality. Preserve goal definition and progress tracking while including milestone notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original description lacks clarity on how progress is monitored and milestones are defined. Rewrite to explicitly state that users can set specific, measurable goals with parameters, track their progress, and receive alerts upon milestone achievement.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG' description includes 'automated milestone alerts' which are not explicitly mentioned in the HLG' reconstruction. However, the HLG' reconstruction captures the core goal of defining goals with parameters and notifying upon achievement. The HLG should be rewritten to ensure it fully encompasses the documentation's requirement for automated milestone alerts while maintaining the core goal of progress tracking.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG excludes version control, which is documented as part of the supported functionality. Preserve content management while including versioning and user notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original goal does not sufficiently emphasize user notifications about new content or features. Rewrite to include explicit mention of transparent user communication regarding updates.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG' reconstruction only mentions distributing and notifying users of new workout content, omitting the global deployment of workout libraries and system settings with version control. The original HLG is inadequately representing the functionality expressed by the LLGs. Rewrite the HLG to include global deployment and version control of workout libraries and system settings, while preserving the distribution and notification functionality.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits automated milestone alerts, which are part of the supported functionality. Preserve goal definition and progress tracking while including milestone notifications.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original HLG excludes version control, which is documented as part of the supported functionality. Preserve content management while including versioning and user notifications.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original description lacks clarity on how progress is monitored and milestones are defined. Rewrite to explicitly state that users can set specific, measurable goals with parameters, track their progress, and receive alerts upon milestone achievement.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the original goal does not sufficiently emphasize user notifications about new content or features. Rewrite to include explicit mention of transparent user communication regarding updates.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG' description includes 'automated milestone alerts' which are not explicitly mentioned in the HLG' reconstruction. However, the HLG' reconstruction captures the core goal of defining goals with parameters and notifying upon achievement. The HLG should be rewritten to ensure it fully encompasses the documentation's requirement for automated milestone alerts while maintaining the core goal of progress tracking.

For 'Manage and update app content and configurations': the HLG' reconstruction only mentions distributing and notifying users of new workout content, omitting the global deployment of workout libraries and system settings with version control. The original HLG is inadequately representing the functionality expressed by the LLGs. Rewrite the HLG to include global deployment and version control of workout libraries and system settings, while preserving the distribution and notification functionality.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG omits 'automated milestone alerts' mentioned in documentation. Preserve goal definition, progress tracking, and include automated milestone alerts.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the original HLG lacks clarity on how users define specific, measurable objectives. Rewrite to include explicit instructions for goal definition, ensuring compatibility with milestone alerts.

For 'Support users in setting and achieving personalized fitness goals': the HLG' description includes tracking progress and automated milestone alerts. The HLG' reconstruction focuses on defining parameters and receiving alerts. To preserve the full supported functionality, the HLG should be rewritten to explicitly include progress tracking as a core component of goal management.

For 'Guide beginners through structured and progressive fitness plans': the original HLG excludes 'step-by-step workout routines' and 'dynamically adapt based on user feedback'. Preserve structured onboarding, include step-by-step routines, and ensure dynamic adaptation.
